headline: Russia Strikes Kyiv High-Rise; Ukraine Drones Hit Ships Near NATO Bulgaria
subheadline: Ballistic missile hits nine-story Kyiv building without warning; Ukrainian naval drones sink vessel, damage Maltese ship CHELSEA 3 near Bulgarian coast.
lede: Russian ballistic missiles struck a nine-story residential building in Kyiv without prior warning, igniting a major fire, while a drone attack on a vocational school in Rivne injured 25 people including two in serious condition. Simultaneously, Ukrainian naval drones sank one vessel and damaged the Maltese-flagged CHELSEA 3 near Bulgaria's coast, marking a significant escalation in Black Sea operations. In the Donbas, Russian forces advanced near Matyashove, Bilytske, Dorozhne, and Novyi Donbas while shelling civilians evacuating Kupyansk, causing casualties among women and a child.

sections.title: Kyiv High-Rise Hit; Black Sea Escalation
sections.body: A Russian ballistic missile struck a nine-story residential building in Kyiv at an unspecified time, causing a fire at the impact site with no prior warning from partners about the launches. A separate drone attack hit a vocational school in Rivne, raising the casualty count to 25 injured including two in serious condition, while a guided Geran-5 missile with cameras struck a warehouse in Lutsk at 02:11, triggering a massive fire. Ukrainian drones attacked two ships near Bulgaria, sinking one and damaging the Maltese dry cargo vessel CHELSEA 3 near Krapets. Russian forces shelled civilians during an evacuation in Kupyansk, with casualties reported among women and a child, and advanced near Matyashove, Bilytske, Dorozhne, and Novyi Donbas.

sections.title: Houthi Missiles Wound Four in Riyadh
sections.body: Saudi Civil Defense confirmed debris from two intercepted Houthi missiles injured four people and damaged 15 homes in Riyadh, while the coalition separately announced intercepting a Houthi UAV in the Riyadh region. Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz signed a six-month order banning fiber optic and cellular-guided drones in Israeli airspace, citing threats from enemies and criminal use. Prime Minister Netanyahu denied meeting Egypt's former intelligence chief Abbas Kamel before the October 7 Hamas attack. British intelligence warned Iran is targeting Jewish communities in the UK, with over 50 arrests in the past year linked to Iranian terror plots, and a 14-year-old was injured in an explosion in the Upper Galilee, now recovering at Barzani Hospital in Nahariya.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Russia's use of ballistic missiles against Kyiv residential targets without warning and precision-guided Geran-5 strikes on urban infrastructure signals a deliberate campaign to degrade civilian morale and overwhelm air defenses. Ukraine's naval drone expansion into waters near NATO member Bulgaria introduces alliance entanglement risks, while Russian atrocities during the Kupyansk evacuation indicate systematic targeting of non-combatants. In the Middle East, Iran's multi-theater proxy pressure — Houthi missile barrages on Saudi Arabia and MI5-confirmed terror plots against UK Jewish communities — demonstrates coordinated external operations alongside Israel's domestic drone restrictions reflecting internal and external threat convergence.
